run_tokens_counter: run the TokensCounter pipeline step to count tokens in each document using a HuggingFace tokenizer
create_tokens_counter_eos: create a TokensCounter instance that counts the EOS token on each document with a custom batch size
run_length_counter: run the LengthCounter pipeline step to build a histogram of document token lengths
test_tokens_counter: test the TokensCounter class with gpt2 tokenizer and count_eos_token enabled
review_length_counter: review the LengthCounter class and its histogram generation of document token counts
